records.source: Her roots grow very deep... she wouldn't be happy in there.
records.translation: 她的根扎得很深……待在那裡不會開心。

records.source: Must be planted indoors or on Ginger Island.
records.translation: 必須種植在室內或薑島上。

records.source: Provides unlimited access to all wallpapers and floors... from the convenience of your home!
records.translation: 讓你足不出戶，無限取用所有壁紙和地板！

records.source: Provides unlimited access to almost every furniture item... from the convenience of your home!
records.translation: 讓你足不出戶，無限取用幾乎所有家具！

records.source: You've found the {0}! It's covered in bug slime...
records.translation: 你找到了{0}！上面沾滿蟲子黏液……

records.source: You've found the Wizard's lost {0}! Better return it to him.
records.translation: 你找到了法師遺失的{0}！最好還給他。

records.source: You received the {0}! You now have the ability to find 'Secret Notes'. These notes reveal rare and useful information, and can be reviewed in your collections tab.
records.translation: 你獲得了{0}！現在可以找到「祕密紙條」。這些紙條會揭示稀有而實用的資訊，並可在收藏分頁中查看。

records.source: You received the {0}! You feel an aura of good fortune surrounding you (luck is permanently increased)!
records.translation: 你獲得了{0}！感覺好運氣息環繞著你（幸運永久提高）！

records.source: This package belongs to someone else.
This can be planted to grow an oak tree.
It has more buttons than a regular remote. Perfect for the avid TV watcher!
records.translation: 按鈕比普通遙控器更多。最適合熱愛看電視的人！
這些晶體輕得不可思議。

records.source: Fish eggs aged in salt to bring out the flavor.
records.translation: 以鹽熟成，帶出鮮味的魚卵。

records.source: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.
records.translation: 獨特螢光使它深受礦石收藏家喜愛。

records.source: Prefers temperature "edges" where cool and warm water meet.
records.translation: 偏好冷暖水流交會的溫度「邊界」。

records.source: A purple grain cultivated by an ancient civilization.
records.translation: 古代文明栽培的紫色穀物。

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 7 days to grow. Harvest with the scythe.
records.translation: 秋季播種，七天成熟。使用鐮刀收割。

records.source: The relatively short hind legs suggest some kind of primordial toad.
records.translation: 相對短小的後腿顯示這是某種原始蟾蜍。

records.source: It may have belonged to ancient pirates.
A small silver fish found in the ocean.
records.translation: 棲息於海洋的小型銀色魚類。

records.source: An ancient doll covered in grime. This doll may have been used as a toy, a decoration, or a prop in some kind of ritual.
records.translation: 沾滿污垢的古代玩偶。可能曾被用作玩具、裝飾品，或某種儀式的道具。

records.source: It's a drum made from wood and animal skin. It has a low, reverberating tone.
records.translation: 以木材和動物皮製成的鼓，音色低沉而迴盪。

records.source: It's a dry old seed from some ancient plant. By all appearances it's long since dead...
records.translation: 某種古代植物乾枯老化的種子。怎麼看都早已失去生命……

records.source: It's the remains of an ancient sword. Most of the blade has turned to rust, but the hilt is very finely crafted.
records.translation: 古代劍的殘骸。大部分劍身已鏽蝕，劍柄卻製作得十分精細。

records.source: Uses a bioluminescent dangler to attract prey.
records.translation: 利用會發出冷光的誘餌吸引獵物。

records.source: A crisp fruit used for juice and cider.
records.translation: 口感爽脆，可用來製作果汁和蘋果酒。

records.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Apple tree. Bears fruit in the fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
records.translation: 二十八天長成成熟蘋果樹，秋季結果。周圍八格「地塊」全數空置時才會生長。

records.source: A tender little fruit with a rock-hard pit.
records.translation: 柔嫩的小水果，果核堅硬如石。

records.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Apricot tree. Bears fruit in the spring. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
records.translation: 二十八天長成成熟杏桃樹，春季結果。周圍八格「地塊」全數空置時才會生長。
閃耀著藍綠光芒的寶石。
